build.command: pnpm exec vite build -c apps/desktop/vite.main.config.ts && pnpm exec vite build -c apps/desktop/vite.preload.config.ts && pnpm exec vite build -c apps/desktop/vite.renderer.config.ts && pnpm exec vite build -c apps/desktop/vite.browser.config.ts && pnpm exec vite build -c apps/desktop/vite.server.config.ts && node scripts/verify-desktop-main-chunks.mjs apps/desktop/dist/main && node scripts/verify-desktop-main-chunks.mjs apps/desktop/dist/server

dev.command: nx run rennet-desktop:build && pnpm --dir apps/desktop exec electron .

lint.command: pnpm exec eslint apps/desktop/src apps/desktop/e2e --max-warnings=0 && pnpm exec biome check apps/desktop/src apps/desktop/e2e apps/desktop/*.ts apps/desktop/*.cjs apps/desktop/*.json
